verdict.rationale: MoonPay's own docs describe outbound webhook events that notify your application of account activity and asynchronous transaction-status updates, including a named sell_transaction_requote_required event. The pack does not show how a consumer registers or subscribes an endpoint, so coverage is partial rather than complete. missing for 10: documented endpoint registration/subscription mechanism, signature verification and retry semantics, a full event catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: MoonPay can send webhook events that notify your application whenever an activity occurs on your account.
They allow you to receive alerts for asynchronous updates to transaction statuses.
Handle the sell_transaction_requote_required webhook to surface in-app requote notifications when a sell price changes.
